convert_script = """
import sys
from docx import Document
import pymupdf

def docx_to_pdf(docx_path, pdf_path):
    doc = Document(docx_path)
    pdf = pymupdf.open()

    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        text = para.text
        if not text.strip():
            continue

        page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)

        style = para.style.name if para.style else ""
        if "Heading" in style or "Title" in style:
            fontsize = 16
        elif "Subtitle" in style:
            fontsize = 14
        else:
            fontsize = 11

        # Simple layout: one paragraph per insertion
        rect = pymupdf.Rect(50, 50, 545, 792)
        page.insert_textbox(rect, text, fontsize=fontsize, fontname="helv")

    if pdf.page_count == 0:
        page = pdf.new_page(width=595, height=842)
        page.insert_textbox(pymupdf.Rect(50, 50, 545, 792), "(empty document)", fontsize=11)

    pdf.save(pdf_path)
    pdf.close()
    print(f"Successfully converted {docx_path} to {pdf_path}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    docx_to_pdf(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2])
"""
await write_file("./convert_docx_to_pdf.py", convert_script)
